0022600151.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-4, 1-2 at home) are 4th in the Central, 3.5 games back, and 13th in the East, coming off a loss in their last game. The Cleveland Cavaliers (3-2, 3-0 at home) are 2nd in the Central, 1.5 games back, and 5th in the East, also on a one-game losing streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost the season series 1-3, including a 123-116 loss in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026. Cavaliers guard Jaylon Tyson is out with an ankle sprain.
